title: Every coin buys a real CSGO skin
blurb: Launch a coin on a CSGO skin. Its creator fees buy the real skin.

parts.note: Cover image — goes in the cover slot at the very top, not in the body.

parts.html:
Pick a CSGO skin. Launch a coin on it. Every trade saves toward buying that exact skin.

When the savings cover its price, we buy the real skin.

Pick a skin, launch the coin

Search any skin: a Karambit, an AWP, a pair of gloves. Dota 2 items work too. The name, ticker and coin image fill in from the skin.

Approve once in your wallet and it's live on pump.fun.

Every trade saves toward it

Creator fees are split on chain the moment the coin launches. 90% saves toward your skin. 10% saves toward a list of big, rare skins. The creator takes 0%.

Any number of coins can pair to the same skin, and they all save for it together.

Then we buy it

When the savings reach the skin's price, the site buys it on Waxpeer automatically. It lands in our public Steam account, and anyone can check it's there.

Then saving starts again toward the next copy.

Pick your skin

Launch one on skinpair.fun
